info.title: CF Meet Developer Platform internal API
info.description: HTTP surface of services/developer-platform: GET /health, GET /ready, the service-authenticated /internal/v1 API and (cfmeet.developer-platform.http-api) the gateway-forwarded customer API under /v1. Every /internal/v1 path, unknown ones included, requires a valid Ed25519 service token whose issuer the Developer Platform's trust bundle grants the route's permission. Customers never reach this service directly: the API Gateway authenticates them (Platform Access credentials, or the CF Meet session verified through the Meeting Service bridge) and forwards a signed request. Section 53: POST /internal/v1/platform/events (developer-event.publish) ingests committed producer events for central customer webhooks, and the gateway-forwarded machine webhook API is served at Calling's public paths (/v1/webhooks*, /v1/webhook-deliveries/{delivery_id}/replay) for the cut-over.

get.description: Readiness: own database reachable and every migration applied.

Foundation route of the customer path. Permission developer-request.forward (API Gateway only); requires the signed delegated platform context, which Platform Access re-validates (platform-identity.read) before the canonical ids are returned and the environment is anchored. Behind DEVELOPER_PLATFORM_GATEWAY_API_ENABLED (default off: 404).

Effective platform entitlements of an application environment (API Gateway quota configuration): organization plan, stricter project plan and environment caps. Permission `developer-entitlement.read`.

post.description: Durable accounting of accepted public API requests and normalized API_OPERATION counts (API Gateway quota flush). The batch is applied exactly once: a replay of an already applied batchId is acknowledged as ALREADY_RECORDED without counting again. Counts only; no request content or caller identity. Permission `developer-usage.record`. A batch carries at least one entry or operation.

operations.description: Normalized API_OPERATION counts (Appendix D): domain, contract operation id and response status class per environment and UTC day.

get.description: Durable accepted-request total of an application environment on a UTC day (0 when none); the API Gateway re-seeds its shared day window from it. Permission `developer-usage.record`.

post.description: Section 53: a producer (Meeting Service, Calling, Privacy Relay, Messaging, Numbering, SMS Gateway) publishes a committed domain event from its transactional outbox (platform envelope). Permission `developer-event.publish`; the envelope's producer_service must be the authenticated caller and its runtime_environment the receiver's; its type must belong to the producer's own domain (unknown families are refused). The event is projected into the public catalog (allow-listed safe keys only; never stored or forwarded verbatim), deduplicated on (producer, event_id) — a duplicate returns the same eventId and creates no delivery — and fanned out to the ACTIVE matching subscriptions of the SAME application environment (recorded SHADOW in shadow mode). 200 = accepted (also for internal-only facts, eventId null); 400 = refused (do not retry); 503 = retry later. Behind DEVELOPER_PLATFORM_WEBHOOKS_ENABLED (off: 404).

Requires webhooks.manage. Every subscribed event type also requires its own read scope (call.* calls.read, voicemail.* enterprise.voicemail.read, recording.* / artifact.* enterprise.recording.read, relay.* privacy.sessions.read, usage.* / limit.* usage.read, sms.* sms.read, conversation.* / message.* messages.read, number.* numbers.read, credential.* credentials.manage, production_access.* production_access.request; meeting.* / participant.* need webhooks.manage only). The endpoint must be a public https URL (re-checked at delivery and connection time; redirects never followed). The signing secret is returned ONCE. Machine credentials only (the console uses /v1/environments/{environmentId}/webhooks); scope (tenant, application, environment) is the credential's confirmed chain: another environment's subscription is 404. Gateway-forwarded: the API Gateway's service token (developer-request.forward) with the signed delegated context naming the authenticated credential; the public contract of this path is Calling's (cfmeet.calling.http-api, cfmeet.platform.webhooks) and the gateway re-points it here when API_GATEWAY_CENTRAL_WEBHOOKS_ENABLED. Behind DEVELOPER_PLATFORM_GATEWAY_API_ENABLED and DEVELOPER_PLATFORM_WEBHOOKS_ENABLED (off: 404).
